business_summary: Skyline Builders Group Holding Limited, through its subsidiary, operates as an approved public works contractor. It undertakes public civil engineering works, such as road and drainage work. The company was incorporated in 2024 and is based in Kowloon Bay, Hong Kong.
business_summary_ko: Skyline Builders Group Holding Limited는 자회사를 통해 승인된 공공 공사 계약자로 운영됩니다. 도로공사, 배수공사 등 공공토목공사를 맡는다. 이 회사는 2024년에 설립되었으며 홍콩 카오룽 베이에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
